take_homes: Split agents only for different access, dialect or stance. Otherwise write one prompt.
A synthesizer needs a framework to pick an answer. Without one it averages the inputs into something beige.
Handoffs are where multi-agent work fails, quietly. Check what gets dropped between retriever and curator.
